notes.title: Playtest Build 3.0 AVAILABLE NOW - Into The Darkness VR
notes.content:
Hey there!

It's time for the final stage of our playtests — and this one's a big one! This time, we're especially focused on Story Mode, and we can't wait to hear what you think. To kick things off, we're sharing the beginning of Into The Darkness VR with you. Dive in, explore, and let us know how it feels!

[previewyoutube=xQm4EoyU6Sg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Changelog: [/b]
[list]
[*] Updated content for Playtest 3.0 [Story Mode]
[*] Reworked backpack behavior
[*] Reworked inventory slot system – now adjustable during gameplay
[*] Stabilized game physics
[*] Improved accuracy when throwing dynamic objects
[*] Optimized overall performance
[*] Optimized VRAM usage and improved streaming pool handling
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[*] Fixed an issue where Oculus/Meta controllers might not function properly
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies sometimes failed to attack the player
[*] Fixed an issue where the game might not render correctly when the wrong default OpenXR platform was selected; OpenXR selection is no longer required
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Playtests are designed for Meta headsets
[*] Clicking "continue" without reaching the first checkpoint will cause the game to load forever
[*] Most settings are currently non-functional – changing them has no effect.
[*] Grabbing enemies may occasionally cause performance drops.
[*] Footstep impact sounds can sometimes repeat rapidly in quick succession.
[*] On systems with slower hard drives, you can experience texture pop-in
[*] Some objects may not be grabbable at this time.
[*] Physics accuracy may decrease during performance drops
[*] If the user is sitting in real life but Frank remains standing in-game, please recalibrate player height in the main menu.
[/list]

We’re eagerly awaiting your feedback! We’ve long known that input during playtests like this is crucial for a successful launch. That’s why we’ll read every comment and watch every video you share to ensure we deliver a top-quality game. notes.title: Playtests for INTO THE DARKNESS VR continue. Our conclusions for the next build
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys! It's time for a little summary of Playtest Build 1.0.
[/b]
First off, a huge thank you for the incredible interest in the playtests! Your feedback and gameplay insights have been invaluable, helping us understand exactly where to focus our improvements. We're already working on the first fixes for quick slots and redesigning the bow mechanics to make them more intuitive. Additionally, we're addressing rare errors with certain headsets and expanding support for less popular models.

[b]But wait, there’s more! Since this is Playtest Build 1.0, you know what that means… Playtest Build 2.0 is on the way!
[/b]
Here’s what you can look forward to in the upcoming release:
[list]
[*] Sandbox Mode
[*] New main menu (more similar to what you will find in the Early Access version)
[*] Option to skip the tutorial
[*] Updated quick slot system

notes.title: Into The Darkness VR: OPEN PLAYTEST AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
Hey guys! Kept you waiting, huh?

After several internal changes at the studio and an extended closed playtest of Into The Darkness VR (we told you to join our Discord!), we’re excited to announce that development of the game, co-created by Cosmos Games and 9 lives, is now in full swing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/3806d4a57c3623dbc227802af0de552e9c00d862.png[/img]

But wait, some of you are probably wondering what's happening with 9 lives and the recent changes in the studio. The simplest way to explain would be to share the graphic we posted on our social media a few days ago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/6e0293cf152e4f4d1e4ad22b3d4fef5739d3d788.png[/img]

[b]It's time to kick off the Into The Darkness VR Open Playtests! You can sign up right now on the game's Steam page and gain instant access![/b]

[b]What can you expect from this version of the game?[/b] This is a specially designed build, developed for you to test various gameplay mechanics, performance, and compatibility across different headsets. The available level is a modified version from the game, stripped of any story elements. The full release will include a wider variety of enemies, more mechanics, plot-integrated tutorials, and much more.

[previewyoutube=Lr3SbywPfUE;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]💥This special build is CPU-heavy due to the large number of enemies you'll be facing simultaneously. We've increased the enemy count to let you experiment with them. However, in the Early Access version, there will be fewer enemies, but they will pose a greater threat.💥[/b][/u]

[b]How long will the playtests last?[/b] For now, we’re leaving the end date open! Our goal is to continuously add more content, and we’re excited to reveal that the next major update will introduce Sandbox Mode, where you’ll have the freedom to do whatever you want.

[b]Important information for users of headsets other than Meta Quest.[/b] At the launch of Into The Darkness VR Early Access, the game will support all popular headsets. However, during the Open Playtest, you’ll only see controls displayed for Meta devices.

[b]Wondering about sharing videos from Into The Darkness VR, like on YouTube?[/b] There are no restrictions! Feel free to share your gameplay footage anywhere you’d like. These videos will provide us with valuable insights into how you experience the game.

[b]When is the premiere of Into The Darkness VR?[/b] We don’t have a definitive answer yet. While we’re currently assembling many completed elements, and the game is taking shape daily, our goal is to launch the Early Access version in the best possible condition. Your feedback from the special level in the Open Playtests will play a crucial role in determining the release date.

[b]We’re eagerly awaiting your feedback! [/b]We’ve long known that input during playtests like this is crucial for a successful launch. That’s why we’ll read every comment and watch every video you share to ensure we deliver a top-quality game. [url=https://forms.gle/qn3rPNSy6G8ax1A7A]Please share your feedback using this link[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/3Fh4ekCkec]Discord Playtest Server[/url].

Be sure to follow us on social media too!

[url=https://www.facebook.com/9livesvr/]FACEBOOK[/url] || [url=https://x.com/9livesvr]X[/url] || [url=https://9livesvr.com/]OUR WEBSITE[/url]

[b]PLAYTEST FAQ[/b]

[b]Q: When do the Open Playtests start?[/b]
A: They’re live now! Register on the game’s Steam page, and you’ll gain immediate access to a special build.

[b]Q: What does the Open Playtest Build include?[/b]
A: You’ll explore a modified level from the game, stripped of any story elements. The full version will feature more enemy types, additional mechanics, plot-integrated tutorials, and much more.

[b]Q: Will the build receive updates?[/b]
A: Yes! We're also developing Sandbox Mode, which will be introduced as a patch during the Open Playtests.

[b]Q: How long will the playtests last?[/b]
A: Currently, there is no set end date for the Open Playtests.

[b]Q: Where can I submit feedback?[/b]
A: You can share your feedback via [url=https://forms.gle/qn3rPNSy6G8ax1A7A]this link[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/3Fh4ekCkec]join our Discord Playtest Server[/url].

[b]Q: I was a Closed Playtester. Is this build different from the last version?[/b]
A: Yes, the latest version includes the following changes:
[list]
[*] Reworked AI ​​of some enemies.
[*] Optimized gameplay performance.
[*] Added DLSS and FSR support for anti-aliasing
[*] Added support for wielding the katana with both hands.
[*] Added combat sounds for MK1 android during battles.
[*] Improved spatial audio with reverb effects.
[*] Fixed issue with sliding down from the lower point on the zipline.
[*] Fixed issue preventing death in some cases.
[*] Fixed minor bugs related to player-world interactions.
[*] Fixed dead android body physics bug.
[*] Fixed bug where androids spiked with arrows couldn't move correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update - Into The Darkness VR
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Welcome to another devlog! Today, we'll give you a quick update on the progress of Into the Darkness VR. Each of the team members is in the process of developing their big components and it's hard to show anything specific at the moment. We understand that the technical details of rebuilding the Unreal Engine to extract more performance may not be interesting (so we will not bore you with that), but we want to assure you that we're making every effort to create a game that uses the full potential of PCVR.

We've recorded a sneak peek of one of the game's rifles in action. The gif showcases the seamless reloading feature, where the magazine can be ejected and replaced with a smooth motion. Additionally, we've added more physical elements to the game by making each bullet a separate object that can land on your weapon. While we understand your eagerness to see gameplay footage, we're excited to share it with you soon. Keep an eye out as we gear up for the [b]early access release of Into the Darkness VR in 2023[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/579d99b071b86017a8404c3cbd628e948a020fc7.gif[/img]

If you want to be even closer to the development process - you are more than welcome to [url=https://discord.gg/dERxD78]join our Discord server[/url] and ask us any questions!

Gameboom VR & Cosmos Games teams

notes.title: Beyond graphics of Into The Darkness VR
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Welcome to another devlog! Today, we're excited to share some updates on the development of Into The Darkness VR. We're constantly improving the game, adding new passages, and enhancing the atmosphere of the location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/d97a697160c82d8e8313f724c719d79a99a8a105.png[/img]

But our goal with Into The Darkness VR is not to create a tech demo that falls short in some way. The stunning graphics are just one aspect of what we're working on. We're also putting a lot of effort into creating realistic physics, advanced AI, and a deep, rich story. We want the game to be more than just a showcase of technology – we want it to be an immersive and engaging experience for players.

[h1]Deeper than graphics[/h1]

The plot of Into The Darkness VR is almost finalized. While we don't want to give away too much, we can assure you that it won't be a simple, cliched story "robots bad, go kill." We've put a lot of thought and effort into the background and context of the game, and we're excited to share more details with you at a later date. For now, suffice it to say that we have prepared a deep, rich story that we think you will really enjoy.

One of the biggest challenges of VR gaming is creating a seamless and enjoyable experience for players. Ladders and climbing can be particularly frustrating, as they can lead to situations in which, for example, we’re already at the top and… we’re falling. That's why we've been working on improving the platforming elements in Into The Darkness VR. Our goal is to create a system that allows players to explore and collect hidden items without encountering frustrating obstacles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/a74fba1d03d4f4d2b40b5876c7d0e07f93398fae.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/882dcb291e3c71e0c72c3f9fe8cc72e66902a08e.gif[/img]

As you may already know, Into The Darkness VR will feature full-body visibility for players. This means that you'll be able to see your entire body as you move through the game world. However, we don't want the physics in the game to be so exaggerated that they become annoying or tiring. We've designed the game to avoid situations where your leg might catch on an object and pull you off balance, so you can focus on enjoying the game without any frustrating distractions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/75310e303b51711781de0af32d2388194f6a9d70.gif[/img]

In addition to the other improvements we've been making, we've also been working on enhancing the AI in Into The Darkness VR. The drones in the game will be able to search for you and avoid obstacles, making combat more exciting and dynamic. Plus, the game's soundtrack will kick in during fights, adding to the excitement and energy of the action scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/da90435809b5cb22095b88e4d8510a98e8f688db.gif[/img]

If you want to be even closer to the development process - you are more than welcome to [url=https://discord.gg/dERxD78]join our Discord server[/url] and ask us any questions!

Gameboom VR & Cosmos Games teams

notes.title: Redesign revealed
notes.content:
Hey guys!

A lot of you have arrived here since the Steam VR festival! Thanks for your interest in the game! If you are new here and looking forward to Into The Darkness VR then the following short introduction below is for you!

[h1]Are you new here?[/h1]

Into The Darkness VR is a title we first showed in 2021. In the meantime, we released a demo of the game, which was liked by so many players that today it is one of the most anticipated VR game on Steam. Players' expectations for Into The Darkness VR have grown so much that comparisons to top VR games have begun. Our reaction to this?

[list]
[*] We increased the budget
[*] We extended the production time to match the new scale of the game
[*] As Gameboom VR, we took care of the game design (the amazing Cosmos Games are responsible for the rest of the game!)
[/list]

The rest since then has been history, which you can follow in the devlogs.

[h1]Remember the tutorial from the demo?[/h1]

If you belong to the group of people who remember the Into The Darkness VR demo, you probably know what the game's tutorial looked like. If you haven't seen it - check out the numerous materials on YouTube! Today we'd like to show you how this level has changed and evolved! Here are new screenshots of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/62738bf6288c29de30611f4e318393bd29b57229.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/0f1f4aa3f3362c05f4aaae2bde61fe1a1e6d1105.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/b05d7cee901e79099b4d8d297cec6bca4e3a4e25.png[/img]

We hope that we meet your expectations.

[h1]New glove feature[/h1]

A little surprise! In the previous devlog, you could see one of the features of the glove, which allows you to manipulate objects with great precision. But that's not all your “hands” will be able to do! Below is a short gif showing you our test of the "push" function. Let us know what you think!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/q7LWrcNy1sA5CPBAws/giphy.gif[/img]

If you want to be even closer to the development process - you are more than welcome to join our Discord server and ask us any questions: https://discord.gg/dERxD78

notes.title: Rescheduling, motion capture and music
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Today we have a lot to tell you about how we improve the quality of the game. Since the demo version that you could have played last summer, we are improving the game in EVERY aspect. The published demo version met with a lot of interest, outlining the further direction of the game development. In previous devlogs, you could see an improved graphic or an enlarged size of the locations. However, these are not the only changes we are constantly introducing in the game. Here are some more aspects that we are improving:

[h1]New and improved mechanics[/h1]

In the demo version, you didn't have a chance to check how exactly crafting will work. In the full version, there will be an improved version of the crafting system waiting for you, which will also be related to the topic of ecology. See how weapons are being made in Into The Darkness VR now!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mp0dRoJQJcs

We improved the gloves that you will have in the game! Now you can use them to precisely manipulate objects, which gives us new possibilities for designing levels and puzzles. And that's not all the functions that gloves will have!

https://youtu.be/POe3PLH8erU

Changes are also taking place in the physics of the game. You like to compare Into The Darkness VR to Boneworks and Half-Life Alyx (by the way... you set the bar high for us! ;)). If we were to define game physics today, it is somewhere in between the two games. We don't want ultra-precise physics, but we also want to let you have some fun with the game. Therefore, we constantly improve and optimize this element.

https://youtu.be/fhpykrc_q6E

There are even more new mechanics, but you will have to wait until the next devlogs.

[h1]Motion Capture[/h1]

To ensure the high quality of the game, we also invest in new technologies. One of them is motion capture equipment, which allows us to create high-quality animations. We decided to use the Xsens solution, which is different from the traditional solution with white balls on the body. Special trackers attached to the suit are much easier to set up, do not require tracking cameras, and fit perfectly into our workflow. This technology is also used by the devs of Creed: Rise to Glory, Tiny Tina's Wonderlands, FIFA 22, Call of Duty Black Ops Cold War, Infamous: Second Son, and many others…

https://youtu.be/PLLtl0Mg7Kc

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/975e9bfd2ff4d58a2c55286fc0314bcab8350f06.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/fabd0a653977416db5f7839adbe2c92edf2e77be.jpg[/img]

[h1]Facial Animation and Voice Recordings[/h1]

Motion capture of the body is one thing, but we also decided to capture our heroes' facial movements! You still have to wait for the effects of our work, but know that Into The Darkness VR characters will not scare you with tired faces.

What there was a lot of criticism for in the Into The Darkness VR demo was, of course, the dialogues and voices you heard. Full agree - this element needed an upgrade, but it was built quickly for this demo. In the full version of the game, voices recorded by voice actors will be waiting for you. All dialogues have also been improved now.

By the way - Into The Darkness VR will have subtitles translated into the following languages: Vietnamese, Polish (our homelands!), English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese.

[h1]New Lucy[/h1]

In the previous devlog we promised to show you the new version of Lucy. The character that you might know from the demo as the blue hologram looks completely different now. Below we present its model, which will receive a few more improvements. Of course, this is not the only person you will meet in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/984da6c8881b725ac90e3d0050311266b1ec5e5e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]

Into The Darkness VR will also receive an original soundtrack. We have established cooperation with several professionals who mix the songs. Here, however, is a little surprise! We are ready to present you with a fragment of one of the songs! Let us know what you think about it!

https://youtu.be/bY1okWiFURU

[h1]Future of Into The Darkness VR development[/h1]

As you can see - the production takes us more time than we initially assumed, but we do all this to raise the quality of Into The Darkness VR. We have a lot of freedom in what we can achieve and we want to use this time to deliver the best game possible. This brings us to the topic of rescheduling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/5f75c71ef172f5e7f4007eb3fdd868d9cb421cd8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39705625/848c674b66071e5a9d39ed24594464d6e5fde3e6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rescheduling[/h1]

We planned playtests for this half of the year. Unfortunately, we will not be able to begin them yet, for which we are very sorry.

We remember that we promised you that you will test the game before the premiere. That plan doesn't change. We still want to share the title with you before release. As soon as we are ready - we will provide you with information on how to test Into The Darkness VR before the premiere.

There is still some work ahead of us, including some topics that we cannot discuss in public yet. However, the work is ongoing and we will show you the individual elements of the game more and more often.



P.S. Some say that on one of the screenshots there is a key for Cooking Simulator VR on Steam…

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Hey guys!

Thank you for waiting patiently for Into The Darkness VR! We've been a bit quiet since we released the gameplay demo, but we want to reassure you that development is progressing.

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/Kunn03Vxh9ifEPLod9/giphy.gif?cid=790b761135006505b695173c050402bdcf8cc33ae520745c&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

[b]What's happening with Into The Darkness VR right now? [/b]

A lot has changed in the game since Cosmos Games started developing Into The Darkness VR. However, in addition to the game itself - the VR games market has changed as well. Currently, you can see a certain division into games exclusive to PCVR and those that are also aimed at Meta Quest.

Nowadays, VR games are mostly planned to run natively on Meta Quest headsets, which imposes some limitations. While we don’t reject the idea of bringing the game to Quest - we decided that we would like to make a full-fledged VR title that maximizes the potential of PC VR. Therefore, we expanded the scope of Into The Darkness VR and significantly expanded the story of the game.

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/eC1H8PajvH8JkUwRZd/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611692120997c4dc91f1a83c0900074eb8c591da9d8&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]


[b]Feedback from the demo[/b]

It was a great idea to publish the gameplay demo. The players on our Discord have given us so much feedback, that we are still implementing ideas and suggestions. Although Into The Darkness VR is a project of a small Cosmos Games studio, many of you thought that it was dealing with an AAA production. You don't even know how it made us happy!

The expectations are high and we don't want to disappoint you. Therefore, GameBoom VR, which until now was only a publisher, joined the production process. Cosmos Games is working on gameplay and GameBoom VR is responsible for the design. We believe that together we will provide you with a fantastic game.

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/Vwuf8mpAHOSs8cjpTI/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611c9d1263ff21cee9858689d2779d1b956e7f668e4&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

[b]What have we changed?[/b]

While we don't want to reveal all the changes we're making to the game just yet, we've decided to reveal a sneak peek of what we're working on.

The locations that we showed you in the demo and on the videos are just a small fragment of what is being prepared. You can expect a greater variety of stages and not always just going from A to B. More complicated missions, more diverse scenery etc.

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/cRxvPtEqdu1fP7WBR3/giphy.gif?cid=790b761139127d05f26a367a6e4ef204d95733c5725bc41b&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

There will also be new gameplay mechanics. We are testing new gadgets that you will be able to use during the game, because in Into The Darkness VR, combat will not have to be a solution in some cases. We check completely new things and analyze their impact on the gameplay.

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/MZFSEepsOHwFOVmB4e/giphy.gif?cid=790b761117718ad438ba91217bbdb7b428e950b5e61299fc&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

It's worth adding that you haven't seen all the opponents in the game yet, and we are planning several types of robots with different behaviors. If you're gamers who like to shoot, we also have good news that the arsenal in the game will be quite large...

As for the story, dialogues, voices, pace of the game, tutorials - we carefully analyzed the players' needs and watched probably all the gameplay videos on YouTube to see "how you play". We change the position and behavior of opponents. We develop the functionality of the base. Basically, during regular meetings, we wonder how to surprise you at every level of the game.

[b]New release year[/b]

Of course, we are also working on fixes, support for certain VR headset models, and many other things. Yes, we have a lot of work to do. But preparing Into The Darkness VR for such a community is pure fun.

The changes we are introducing, expanding the scope of the game... as you probably guessed, all this takes a long time and Into The Darkness VR will not debut in 2021. As such, we announce that the new release year is 2022. We promise that we will inform you regularly about changes in the game.

If you want to be even closer to the development process - join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/dERxD78

New demo coming next year!

Into The Darkness VR changed as a result of the feedback we received from you being able to play the demo. We appreciate your opinion and we want to continue this way of communication with you.

That's why we announce that in early 2022 there will be another version of the Into The Darkness VR demo, which will include the changes we've been working on over the past months. We are not hiding anything - you will be able to check the game for free and tell us what you think.

Cosmos Games and GameBoom VR Teams

HD version of published videos and screenshots available to download [url=https://u.pcloud.link/publink/show?code=XZVPUNXZjexqhsjDDvucyv44lWUrs0PftuOV]here.[/url]

notes.title: Another demo update (0.6.0) is live! WMR support, QUEST + VD instructions
notes.content:
Hi there,

thanks for the continuous feedback. We are working hard to fix all the issues and make sure that everyone will be able to try the demo! We are still have issues with WMR bindings, we will provide the devs with proper device and try to fix the issue as soon as possible.
Here is the changelog:
[list]
[*] fixed hand position after melee weapon break
[*] disabled elevator collision channel for auto crouching
[*] optimized player pose for lower crouching
[*] add versioning text ingame for feedback purposes
[*] fixed a bug where player cannot continue after shoot all the bullet in Shooting Range Tutorial level
[*] optimized hand size
[*] auto update height when player is using controller to move
[*] updated UI distance to camera
[*] disabled UI appear at item when grab
[/list]

To play the game via Oculus Quest + Virtual Desktop make sure that SteamVR is closed and run the game through Oculus Dash in headset.

Best,
Mateusz | Gameboom VR

notes.title: Demo update is live!
notes.content:
Hi there,

thanks for all the valuable feedback! We know that your expectations are high and we will work hard on the game to meet them. Keep in mind that this is not AAA title, but a game made by small indie dev studio. Regardless of that we will do our best to up the quality in all departments in coming months.
We addressed most of the issues that were possible to fix in short time. If you encountered any issues in previous version, we recommend starting New Game. Here is the full changelog of the new update:
[list]
[*] fixed bug in tutorial level where player finish shooting and cannot continue,
[*] fixed bug in Warehouse where scanner next to the big door that lead to the ending of level,
[*] small climbing optimisation,
[*] player height optimisation so player can crouch and grab object on floor,
[*] minimum player height set to 120,
[*] fix vive controller input binding,
[*] changes in save architecture to boost performance in some areas (it’s better to start New Game and delete old saves),
[*] fixed grammar in dialogues,
[*] add more sound effects.
[/list]



The issue with HP Reverb and Quest + Virtual Desktop is still not solved, but we are working on it. If it’s not solved until the end of Steam Next Fest, we will make the demo available longer than planned, so all of you have the opportunity to play the game.


Best,
Mateusz | Gameboom VR
